notes: Fixes the Batch Split multi-cover image loader that could reject every selected PNG with a null-valued expression error. The multi-wrap flow now uses a dedicated byte-backed safe image loader with guarded stream/image/graphics cleanup, while the working single-wrap loader is left unchanged. The existing inline multi-wrap editor and the v1.0.9 temporary full-wrap rule are preserved. Windows PowerShell parsing, synthetic current-source patching, a valid PNG runtime load test, payload validation, and all internal SHA-256 checks passed before publish.
